description: 24-sentence Indian Hinglish TTS benchmark: 8 Roman Hinglish, 8 Devanagari Hinglish (English loanwords in Devanagari), 8 code-switched (Devanagari Hindi + Latin English). Written for this benchmark (not in the training data), typed the way people write each script; includes digits, currency, abbreviations, questions, the danda and two inputs without terminal punctuation to exercise the text front-end.
